brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.requirement: Two-storey tower (structure spans level 0 and level 1)
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full stacked with snap:0,0,0;full ; also half-w columns 1,0,0 and 1,0,1 joined with jointBolts - gives level 0 and level 1 height (160mm)

drawer:0#1,0#cut (slide drawer on 1,0,0 half-w at level0) and drawer:1#1,0#cut (slide drawer on 1,0,1 half-w at level1) = 2 slide drawers; notch drawer frames hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm at 0,1 levels 0 and 1 provide additional storage frame

finish.summary: Built a compact two-storey tower: full hex column at 0,0 (levels 0-1) flanked by half-w column at 1,0 (levels 0-1) bolted with jointBolts, topped with covers. Two slide drawers fitted to the half-w bases (one per storey) satisfy the ≥2 drawer requirement; two notch drawer-frame trays between adjacent cells add storage. check_build is clear.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
